      function toggleTracebackView() {
        const browserView = document.getElementById('browserTraceback');
        const pastebinView = document.getElementById('pastebinTraceback');
        const toggleBtn = document.getElementById('toggleView');
        
        if (browserView.style.display === 'none') {
            browserView.style.display = 'block';
            pastebinView.style.display = 'none';
            toggleBtn.textContent = 'Plaintext view';
        } else {
            browserView.style.display = 'none';
            pastebinView.style.display = 'block';
            toggleBtn.textContent = 'Interactive view';
        }
      }

      function copyTraceback() {
        const tracebackText = document.getElementById('traceback_area').value;
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(tracebackText).then(() => {
            alert('Traceback copied to clipboard!');
        }).catch(err => {
            console.error('Failed to copy: ', err);
        });
      }
    </script>
